title: Protection paladin: Hands of Reckoning on a mob off the healer and off a DPS player

rules.desc: A mob that hits the healer (extra1) or the DPS player gets Hand of Reckoning (or Righteous Defense) from the Protection paladin on that mob within 5 s, at least 50 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 12 s, one counted answer per 10 s)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:51-54 (lose aggro -> hand of reckoning at ACTION_MOVE, judgement at ACTION_MOVE - 1), :58-60 (party member attacked -> hand of reckoning on attacker at ACTION_MOVE, #1156), :19,23 (both fall back to righteous defense); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: both paladin taunt rows sit at ACTION_MOVE, far below the warrior's INTERRUPT+1, so threat and seal rows can win the tick first. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
